qte_sweep._doc: Per-phase timing QTE (Austin approved 2026-11-11 10:56 PM PT; sim pin f0efecf). One sweep each during playback (shots11, Austin 2026-11-12): the cars hold at the Entry / Apex / Exit point while that phase's timer (lead + base zone + tail, at least result_hold_s after the score) runs, the road keeps scrolling, then they drive on. Zone width = qte_zone_width(r, qte_window_mod) x QTE_ZONE_BASE_MS (sim equations.py:346 / :133), the same for all three. Score of a press = max(0, 1 - |e| / (zone/2)), e = press time - zone centre (equations.py:280 docstring). The cursor passing the zone's far edge = unplayed = 0 (Barry's sim; Austin: unplayed scores 0). Every number below is a PLACEHOLDER (display only, never read by the sim).

terrain._doc: DISPLAY (Gordon, Austin pt137u pic 5 voids): the roadside continues past the approved kit (outside slope -7.5 m at 9 m, inside hill band 10 m at 18 m) at the same outside gradient (7.5/8.45) and a gentle 0.35 rise inside, out to reach_m = fog_far 78 + 22 m (the furthest any race camera sits from the road edge: lot overview 14 m, plan stops), so no camera sees past the dressing before the fog hides it. clear_m (course.gd build_caps): the roadside KIT only stops at another part of the course when its profile would pass within this of that road's height; the far TERRAIN stops at another leg unless it dives >= clear_m under that road (tcap, rule 3), so no hill hangs over a lower leg. Each terrain band edge hangs a skirt of max(skirt_m, the drop to the neighbour terrain at that edge + 1 m) (tstep), so the step between two levels is closed. Checked by the void sweep (--void-sweep, VOID_CHECK). road_clear_m: a skirt stops this far above any road whose gallery line (gallery_wall_m past its edge) it would hang into (tskmax); where a band's cut edge lies under the neighbour's terrain its face continues up to that surface (tup). gallery_wall_m: a road running under another leg gets walls this far past each edge, up to the leg overhead (groof). step_lap_m: at a step between two levels the higher band runs this far past the lower band's edge (tband), so no slot between the skirt and the up face opens to the sky. drop_lat_m / drop_dy_m / drop_min_run_m (item 15, course.gd terrain_drop_runs): where another leg runs within drop_lat_m and differs in height by >= drop_dy_m the drop (guardrail) side faces the LOWER leg and the lattice the higher one; runs shorter than drop_min_run_m merge; 0 = corner rule only. Checked by tools/touge_race/drop_side_check.gd.

turnout._doc: TOUGE turnout after the swap turn (Austin 2026-11-19: 'a small parking area that the cars go into, swap places, and then leave the parking area. They do not stop, they just slow down.'). Arthur's spec: a placeholder straight ~40 m, a little wider. EVERY NUMBER HERE IS A DISPLAY PLACEHOLDER (not sim).
turnout._numbers: PLACEHOLDERS (Gordon). total_m = extra straight after turn 5 the cars cover during the swap (keeps the road continuous into turn 6). pocket_m 60 (Arthur suggested ~40 m; 60 keeps the slower car inside the pocket for the whole swap at these speeds). duration 7 s, speed dips to 30 % (never stops). swap_u: the order flips between 30 % and 70 % of the sequence while the leader is in the pocket; in_u / out_u: leader drifts in / out.
turnout._lot: Lot geometry matches Arthur's approved two-row kit (ccd1126, 2026-11-19): approach 30 m after turn 5's exit, 62 m long incl. 14 m entrance / exit tapers, 18.873 m deep, island curb 0.1-0.7 m, two 5.0 x 2.5 m stall rows at 70 deg. Through-aisle x 0.75-6.75 m (6.0 m clear). lane_near_m / lane_deep_m = 2.4 / 4.9 m beyond the road edge, so two ~2.0 m cars pass with about 0.5 m between them. The P sign is on the island at (0.40, 15.0) m. Duration 8.5 s keeps the entry speed ~20 m/s (playback scroll 21 m/s). Camera: hold after the swap turn's Exit QTE until cam_hold_u, then a fixed shot from the lot's exit end on the valley side of the road (cam_lot), then chase.

lookback._doc: Arthur Pass 4 head-on look-back (districts/README.md:80): 1.0 m back from the car centre, 1.22 m up, looking 30 m straight back along the player's line. Toggle in every race (Austin).

qte_cams._doc: DISPLAY PLACEHOLDERS. Three QTE camera types (outside / front / chase) for each Entry, Apex and Exit section. Inside was removed (Austin pt132u). A seeded display-only RNG (race seed + seed_offset) picks one type per section per turn. It is never the sim RNG and never the AI QTE RNG (offset 104729). --qte-cam TYPE or force overrides every section for review (outside, front, or chase). Every pose still goes through cam_guard (no clipping into walls, guardrails, the lattice or the cut slope). Outside follows the drop / valley side, opposite Track.inside_sign, including hairpins. These cameras are used during TIMING playback QTE sections; planning stop cameras are unchanged.

outside._doc: Geometric outside of the corner (the drop / valley side, opposite inside_sign), including hairpins.

front._doc: Ahead of the car along the course, looking back at it.

chase._doc: The B.5b fixed chase camera (display.json camera.*) with an optional fov override.

framing._doc: DISPLAY PLACEHOLDERS (Austin pt137u): every QTE camera keeps both cars in frame. Aim at the midpoint of the two cars' bounding spheres (centre = car origin + center_y_m, radius radius_m), widen the fov (never below the type's fov, at most max_fov) until both fit with margin_deg, else pull back step_m at a time (up to max_back_m). After cam_guard the fov may widen again up to max_fov_guarded.
framing._fallback_doc: Austin pt137u item 3: the drawn type is kept when both cars fit (after cam_guard, fov <= max_fov_guarded) and both sight lines run less than los_tol_m deep through the kit model (cam_guard.clip minus its margin: a rail or lamp post between camera and car is fine, a hill is not); otherwise the section shows the first other valid type that does (QTE_CAM_TYPES order, no RNG draw), else the best ranked. QTE_CAM_FALLBACK logs each switch.

cam_guard._doc: PLACEHOLDER (Gordon): camera clearance from the touge kit, an analytic model of the meshes (lattice face 7.2 m rise over 5.0 m run from W+0.7 = mtn_lattice_slope_g bounds; guardrail box 0.33-0.70 m beyond the edge, 0.85 m high; lamp posts r 0.3; cedar cards r = 0.2 x height). margin covers the near-plane half-extents (near 0.1 m, fov 57-66 deg, 4:3 -> 0.08 x 0.06 m) plus snap jitter.
